name: @vineethnkrishnan/notion-mcp

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches across all pages and databases in the Notion workspace. Use this to find content by title or text. Only returns content shared with the integration.

filter.description: Filter results to only pages or only databases.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Retrieves page properties including title, created time, last edited time, parent, and all property values. Use when you have a specific page ID.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID (UUID or 32-char hex).

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Retrieves the full content of a page as readable text blocks. Recursively fetches nested blocks (toggles, columns, etc.) up to a configurable depth. Returns flattened plain text optimized for LLM consumption.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID (UUID or 32-char hex).

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for nested blocks (default: 3).

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Creates a new Notion page. Must specify either parent_database_id (to add a row to a database) or parent_page_id (to create a sub-page). Properties should match the parent database schema.

parent_database_id.description: Database ID to create the page in (mutually exclusive with parent_page_id).

parent_page_id.description: Page ID to create a sub-page under (mutually exclusive with parent_database_id).

properties.description: JSON string of the page properties object (Notion property format).

children.description: JSON string of block content array to add as page body.

tools.name: update_page_properties
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing Notion page. Only the specified properties are changed; omitted properties remain unchanged.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID (UUID or 32-char hex).

properties.description: JSON string of the properties to update (Notion property format).

tools.name: append_blocks
tools.description: Appends block content to the end of a page or block. Use this to add text, headings, lists, and other content to an existing page.

block_id.description: The page or block ID to append children to (UUID or 32-char hex).

children.description: JSON string of block array to append (Notion block format).

tools.name: archive_page
tools.description: Archives (soft-deletes) a Notion page. The page can be restored from the trash in Notion.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID to archive (UUID or 32-char hex).

tools.name: get_database
tools.description: Retrieves database metadata including title, description, and property schema (column definitions). Use this to understand the structure of a database before querying it.

database_id.description: The Notion database ID (UUID or 32-char hex).

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Queries a Notion database with optional filter and sort objects. Returns matching entries with all property values. Use Notion's native filter syntax.

database_id.description: The Notion database ID (UUID or 32-char hex).

filter.description: Notion filter object (see Notion API docs for filter syntax).

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Lists all users in the Notion workspace including name, email, type (person/bot), and avatar URL.
